---
id: "smk-10"
title: "Bayern Munich"
---

Bayern Munich is a professional football club from Munich, the capital of Bavaria in Germany. Founded in 1900 by a group of players who split from an existing gymnastics club, it has become the most successful club in German football, with dozens of Bundesliga championships and many German Cup victories. Bayern has also won the European Cup and its successor, the Champions League, several times, including a treble of league, cup and European title in 2013 and again in 2020. The club plays at the Allianz Arena, a stadium on the northern edge of the city that opened in 2005 and can change the colour of its exterior. Bayern is organised as a members' association with a large number of registered supporters, and its rivalry with Borussia Dortmund is the most prominent in the modern Bundesliga.
